usedFor: Drip holds subscribers and email activity, and “Update Spreadsheet Row” rewrites a Google Sheets row after “Updated Lead Score”.

bestTemplate.name: “Updated Lead Score” in Drip, then “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: The sheet row for a subscriber gets its columns updated each time the lead score changes.

watchOut: “Update Spreadsheet Row” edits an existing row, so a “New Subscriber” needs a row in the sheet first.
